message.content: From the information available, it seems that Wolfgang's upcoming trip to Hong Kong is known to several individuals. Specifically, Wolfgang himself has shared his travel plans with LiHua, mentioning he will be off to Hong Kong for a couple of days next week. Additionally, Wolfgang has informed Yuriko about his trip, suggesting he might bring a souvenir or unique snack from Hong Kong. Furthermore, Wolfgang has also communicated his absence from practice this week due to his business trip to Hong Kong, informing the group that he hopes they have a great time without him and asking them to save some cool tunes for his return. This indicates that Wolfgang's trip to Hong Kong is known to LiHua, Yuriko, and the group he practices with.
